SELECT t2.id, t1.market_name, t2.market_tenant, t2.market_id, t2.report_url, t2.enabled FROM market_config t1 INNER JOIN market_monthly_report_url t2 on t1.id = t2.market_id
and t1.market_name like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%')
and t2.enabled = #{query.enabled}
order by t2.create_time desc
